title: Switchboard: AI change workflows on AWS
description: An AI workflow demo on AWS that checks customer change requests, requires human approval, and confirms that events reach the new destination.
seoTitle: Switchboard | AI Change Workflows on AWS | Hanif Carroll
seoDescription: Explore Switchboard, an AI change workflow built with Python, LangGraph, and AWS. Investigate customer requests, review evidence, approve changes, and check delivery.
role: Workflow design, backend and agent engineering, frontend, and deployment
problem: Changing where customer events are sent requires checking the request, company policies, and the destination before making an update.
solution: Built an AI investigator that checks customer records and policies and links its findings to the evidence.
Required approval from another authorized employee before applying a change and checking delivery.
Deployed on AWS with SAM and CloudFormation, automated releases, and monitoring.
result: A public demo with fictional customer data, real AI investigations, human approval, and signed test events between controlled AWS endpoints.
